scope: Focused related regressions; not the complete Mac suite.
procedure: Fresh build and DLL execution for each listed group using --no-restore --disable-build-servers -p:UseSharedCompilation=false -m:1 -nr:false. ScriptScrollStability was rerun after strengthening actual font-size coverage and passed 245 with both default and supplied-local-source routes.

native.environment: Disposable native MainWindow; synthetic ROM and intercepted filesystem; automatic 500ms compilation polling in the probe.
native.action: Use earlier-section caret, scroll to later section bottom, insert Enter and let pending compilation settle.

limitations: No personal ROM/profile opened or modified.
User story is retained only in a temporary local reproduction; committed fixture uses neutral dialogue.
Synthetic function-table name replaced with numeric placeholder; no gameplay certification.
Original keyboard/model caret reveal checks remain enabled.
Full Mac suite and upstream xUnit suite not rerun.
